# iosxe_parameter_map_webauth_global (Data Source)

This data source can read the Parameter Map Webauth Global configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_parameter_map_webauth_global" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `virtual_ip_ipv4` (String) Virtual IPv4 address.
- `virtual_ip_ipv6` (String) Virtual IPv6 address.
